label: Micro-podcast (conversación a distancia)
principles: Two or more separately recorded vertical takes must read as one conversation: the listener is never frozen (generated listening clip from a real closed-mouth frame).
Level each speaker's loudness separately before the final normalization.

Every join of the footage is a decision: a change of speaker gets the strongest transition; inside the host's take a lighter one; inside the guest's answer a dry cut by default (Walter, ep02 31-oct) — knobs transicionCambioPersona / transicionDentroConductor / transicionDentroInvitado.
The guest is introduced with verifiable authority: official logo, name, role and one sourced fact.
Reuse the series' approved intro and tag exactly; take colors, fonts and captions from the host's brand.
